title: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter
responsibility: Invokes the configured Claude CLI and validates its completed benchmark turn and reported model.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.constructor.executable
inputs.description: Provider CLI executable name or path; defaults to the adapter provider.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight._candidate
inputs.description: Candidate configuration retained by the shared runner preflight interface.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Candidate, isolated workspace, prompt, optional session and shared abort signal.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.command.input
inputs.description: Candidate, isolated workspace, prompt, optional session and shared abort signal.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight
outputs.description: Installed provider CLI version after checking supported configuration.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.run
outputs.description: Completed provider turn with a valid session and matching reported model.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.command
outputs.description: Explicit native CLI argument vector without launching a provider.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unavailable provider execution, unsupported settings or a missing or mismatched completed turn.
